project: QORE-VLM Phase 8A doubly-robust counterfactual passage influence diagnostic

baseline.equivalence_test: With only full_context_probe enabled, selected passage IDs, order, generated prompt, deterministic prediction hash, EM, and F1 must exactly match the existing qore_answer K=5 path on fixed fixtures and a smoke sample.

core_invariants: QORE plus Answer Scorer at K=5 remains the fixed selection baseline; Phase 8A does not modify select_passages or any QUBO coefficient.
Dataset loading, retrieval, gold answers, Generator prompt semantics, evaluate_answer, EM, and F1 remain outside the research plugin boundary.
Probe inclusion is assigned before generation from a stable question identifier and a frozen randomization seed; gold answers, predictions, and outcome metrics cannot enter assignment.
The balanced subset design uses eight mask-complement pairs over the five selected passages, giving treatment propensity 0.5 for every passage in the effect-fit probes.
Full-context and empty-context anchors are descriptive controls and are excluded from propensity-weighted effect fitting.
Question-grouped cross-fitting prevents any question from contributing to both nuisance-model fitting and held-out effect evaluation.

The one-click runner resolves the frozen reference generator from an explicit CLI override, the legacy project path, or the pinned local Hugging Face snapshot in that order; the resolved path, model ID, revision, and config hash are written to the manifest.

Only compact identifiers, masks, numeric covariates, prediction hashes, outcomes, timing, and fit diagnostics may be written to Exchange; raw questions, passages, answers, and predictions are forbidden.
Full Wiki-DPR and full-corpus execution remains collaborator-only.

interfaces.input_schema: question stable ID; five selected passage ranks in baseline order; probe seed; numeric non-gold passage covariates
interfaces.output_schema: ordered ContextProbe records containing stable probe ID, five-bit inclusion mask, ordered selected ranks, anchor flag, and assignment propensity
invariants: baseline full mask preserves exact selected order
every non-anchor mask has a unique complement
each passage is included in exactly eight of sixteen effect-fit probes
probe order randomization is deterministic and independent of gold outcomes

interfaces.input_schema: compact probe outcomes joined to frozen probe assignments and numeric covariates
interfaces.output_schema: per-question per-passage difference-in-means and cross-fitted AIPW influence estimates; bootstrap uncertainty; stability, nuisance, placebo, and gate summaries
invariants: known propensity is 0.5 for effect-fit rows
anchors never enter the AIPW fit
all reported estimates are deterministically reproducible from compact rows

plugins.insertion_point: after fixed qore_answer selection and before the unchanged Generator.generate call
plugins.hypothesis: A null observation adapter can expose the full selected context without changing baseline selection or generation behavior.
plugins.input_schema: five selected passage ranks in baseline order
plugins.output_schema: one full-mask ContextProbe with unchanged passage order and anchor=true
plugins.resource_estimate: One existing baseline generation per question; no additional model or selection call.
failure_signatures: selected IDs or order differ from baseline
prompt or prediction hash differs from baseline
baseline EM/F1 differs from the existing path

plugins.insertion_point: after full_context_probe and before unchanged generation; appends effect-fit and empty-anchor contexts without mutating the baseline probe
plugins.hypothesis: Balanced randomized inclusion interventions expose stable passage-specific generator utility that static relevance, diversity, and answer-identity proxies miss.
plugins.input_schema: full-mask ContextProbe; stable question ID; probe seed; five selected ranks; non-gold numeric passage covariates
plugins.output_schema: the baseline full probe, sixteen unique effect-fit probes arranged as eight complement pairs, and one empty-context anchor
plugins.resource_estimate: Seventeen additional deterministic generations per question; 850 additional generations for the 50-question pilot.
failure_signatures: inclusion counts are not exactly balanced
duplicate or non-complement masks are emitted
gold or prediction data affects assignment
probe generation exceeds the predeclared cap

plugins.insertion_point: after the unchanged generator and evaluate_answer have produced compact probe outcomes
plugins.hypothesis: A cross-fitted AIPW estimate of passage inclusion effect has reproducible conditional answer-utility signal after accounting for Answer Scorer, retrieval rank, context size, token count, and embedding redundancy.
plugins.input_schema: effect-fit probe assignments with propensity 0.5; compact F1/EM outcomes; frozen non-gold covariates; question-grouped fold assignments
plugins.output_schema: per-passage influence estimates and uncertainty plus split-half, nuisance-model, placebo, and pre-registered gate decisions
plugins.resource_estimate: Five-fold ridge nuisance fits, 5000 question-cluster bootstrap samples, and permutation placebos over at most 800 effect-fit rows; no model call.
failure_signatures: AIPW and raw difference-in-means disagree materially
split-half influence stability is below the gate
effect signal vanishes after nuisance control
placebo assignments produce an equal or stronger signal
a question leaks across fit and evaluation folds
the estimator consumes raw text or gold-derived covariates

composition.merge_rule: full_context_probe creates the immutable baseline anchor; balanced_subset_probe appends uniquely keyed context probes; the existing generator and evaluator fill compact outcomes at the declared boundary; doubly_robust_influence joins only by stable probe ID and cannot feed results back to selection or generation.
interaction_ablations: full_context_probe only for exact baseline equivalence
AIPW without outcome-model covariates versus AIPW with frozen nuisances
first four versus last four complement-pair split-half stability
true assignment versus within-question complement-preserving placebo assignment
fixed baseline passage order anchor versus randomized-order effect probes

validation.baseline_equivalence: The null full-context probe must be byte-equivalent at the prompt boundary and exactly equal at selected IDs, order, prediction hash, EM, and F1 on deterministic fixtures.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation questions 200-249 with Wiki-DPR compressed retrieval, top 50 candidates, fixed qore_answer K=5 selection
reproducibility.environment: record Python executable/version, git revision, config SHA-256, plugin tree hash, resolved reference generator path, model ID, pinned revision, model config hash, dataset slice, retrieval settings, selection seed, probe seed, fold hash, and bootstrap seed

limitations: This stage is a diagnostic plan, not an implemented selector and not evidence that counterfactual influence improves F1.
The AIPW treatment is passage inclusion under the frozen five-passage qore_answer context distribution; it does not identify effects for arbitrary retrieved candidates.
Randomized prompt order marginalizes position effects but increases variance; a positive result still needs an explicit order-sensitivity audit.
F1 and EM are discontinuous outcomes, so effect estimates may be sparse and noisy on 50 questions.
A passing Phase 8A gate authorizes only a separate distilled-surrogate plan; it does not authorize a production selector or paper claim.
Novelty remains provisional against RAG attribution, Shapley valuation, and data-importance literature.
